title: Pass percentages of Indian professional exams: CA, CS and CMA (2016 onwards)
description: Every pass percentage published by ICAI (CA), ICSI (CS) and ICMAI (CMA) since 2016, compiled in one dataset with a link to the official source for each row. Covers CA Foundation, Intermediate/IPCC and Final; CSEET, CS Executive and Professional; CMA Foundation, Intermediate and Final, by group where published. Maintained by Gradehunt (https://gradehunt.com/pass-percentage), which is not affiliated with ICAI, ICSI or ICMAI.
